# Creighton Digital
> Done-for-you professional websites and custom Android apps. Based in Santa Maria, California — available worldwide.

## Site Purpose
Creighton Digital helps small and mid-sized businesses get professional websites and custom Android apps without agency complexity or unclear pricing.

- /website-packages.html : Detailed website package options and pricing

## Services
- Done-for-you website packages starting at $799
- Custom Android app development starting at $2,999
- Mobile-friendly design, SEO setup, hosting, and support included in website packages
